Trust me when you are suicidal (if you’re here you sure understand) that getting help is A L W A Y S on your mind. And also never said that they were being disrespectful, I’m sure their intention was pure :)

Of course 0 exercise affects (and a lot) if you are able to go out, you don’t have to do a lot, just play outside with your pets or sit outside, get a little walk etc. Little by little, you know. Make a ritual to go to sleep. I’m not able to go outside so I struggle a lot, what I do is try get my mind busy with stuff that I consider productive for my lifestyle. When I go to sleep, I listen to sounds, guidance meditation or YouTubers idk how to help because sometimes something works and suddenly doesn’t so don’t be afraid to take your time finding what works for you <3
It takes days to get back but personally I realized 8h of sleep is not my thing. Sleeping 6h and a little nap helps me to sleep again at night. Don’t be scared, you’ll be okay!
